messages:
maria_marketing: Heads-up: Catalyze case interview confirmed Thu 9am PT w/ their CTO. Planning blog + short launch post next week and webinar two weeks out. Need hero quote, logo permission, and legal sign-off on any metrics by EOD Fri. Who owns transcript, clips, and webinar copy?

jasper_growth: I can own webinar scheduling + inbound nurture. Will tag leads campaign=catalyze-case. Need final publish URL Mon EOD to wire registration.

emi_content: I'll do ASR -> 1-pass clean and produce 3 social snippets + a 45s highlight. Please drop raw audio right after the call.

rachel_prod: I'll draft hero copy and a short moderator intro for the webinar promo. Two headline options: metric and qualitative. Which do we send to legal?

maria_marketing: Send qualitative first for branding. If Catalyze provides provenance for numbers, we'll use metric headline. Emi, mark any numeric lines as [CLAIM: source needed].

legal_team: Note: numeric claims require provenance (time period or measurement method) or we recommend qualitative phrasing. Please email verbatim quote + context to legal-review@redwood.com. Typical turnaround ~48 hours.

emi_content: Will tag transcript and pull a 10-phrase benchmark blurb to use as a callout.

embargo-bot: Reminder: placeholder embargo set for 2026-03-25 08:00 PDT if legal clears by 2026-03-23 17:00.

jasper_growth: If legal needs redactions, we should still publish blog/social (qualitative) and hold webinar emails. That keeps lead routing live.

maria_marketing: Agreed. Action items:
- Ask Catalyze for written logo use + partner naming perms
- Capture any metric phrasings on-record during interview and paste here
- Emi to deliver transcript + clips by Fri AM
- Legal to review upon receipt of exact quote

emi_content: Got it. I'll post the raw link + timecodes in this thread within 1 hour of the interview.

maria_marketing: Thanks team  will create shared folder and invite legal + jasper + emi + rachel. Updating thread after interview with file links and suggested hero copy.
